title: N -W F P Power Crushers Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Power Crushers Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE POWER CRUSHERS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE POWER CRUSHERS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Power Crushers (Licensing),
Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 29th January, 2002]
No. 1egis.1(12)80/588-93,
dated 29-1-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and
commencement, ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Power Crushers (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Power Crushers Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2 of N.-W.F.P. Ord. XV of 1980

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE POWER CRUSHERS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE POWER CRUSHERS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Power Crushers (Licensing),
Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 29th January, 2002]
No. 1egis.1(12)80/588-93,
dated 29-1-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
2. Amendment of section 2 of
N.-W.F.P. Ord. XV of 1980:--In the North-West Frontier Province Power
Crushers (Licensing) Ordinance, 1980 (N.-W.F.P. Ord. No. XV of 1980),
hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 2, the existing
clause (a) shall be re-lettered as "(aa)" and before clause
"(aa)" so re-lettered the following new clause shall be inserted,
namely:
"(a)
'commercial cane crusher' means a power crusher of more than 12.5 horse power working on one or more than one Karrai
(cooking pot) of not more than 36 cubic
feet in size and 330 kilograms in capacity;"

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Power Crushers Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of N.-W.F.P. Ord. XV of 1980

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE POWER CRUSHERS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE POWER CRUSHERS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Power Crushers (Licensing),
Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 29th January, 2002]
No. 1egis.1(12)80/588-93,
dated 29-1-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
3. Amendment of section 3 of
N.-W.F.P. Ord. XV of 1980.--In the said Ordinance, for section 3, the
following shall be substituted, namely:
"3. Power crushers to
be registered/licensed.--No person shall crush sugarcane by means of
Gur Ghani and power crushers unless,--
(a)
in case of Gur Ghani or a power crusher, other than a commercial cane crusher, it is registered, and
(b)
in case of a commercial cane crusher, it is licensed,
under this Ordinance and every
such Gur Ghani and power/cane crusher, so registered or licensed, shall be
operated subject to such conditions and restrictions as may be imposed by the
authority empowered in this behalf.".

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Power Crushers Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4 of N.-W.F.P. Ord. XV of 1980

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE POWER CRUSHERS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE POWER CRUSHERS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Power Crushers (Licensing),
Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 29th January, 2002]
No. 1egis.1(12)80/588-93,
dated 29-1-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
4. Amendment of section 4 of
N.-W.F.P. Ord. XV of 1980.--In the said Ordinance, for section 4, except
the proviso thereto, the following shall be substituted, namely:
"4. Licensing
authority.--The authority having power-to register a Gur Ghani/power
crusher, other than a commercial cane crusher, or, as the case may be, to grant
licence in respect of a commercial cane crusher, under this Ordinance,
hereinafter referred to as the licensing authority, shall be the District
Officer (Revenue and Estate) of the District concerned."

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Power Crushers Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 5 of N.-W.F.P. Ord. XV of 1980

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE POWER CRUSHERS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE POWER CRUSHERS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Power Crushers (Licensing),
Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 29th January, 2002]
No. 1egis.1(12)80/588-93,
dated 29-1-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
5. Amendment of section 5 of
N.-W.F.P. Ord. XV of 1980.--In the said Ordinance, in section 5,--
(a)
in subsection (1), for the words "for the grant of licence", the
words and commas "for the
registration or, as the case may be, grant of licence;'.' shall be substituted;
(b)
in subsection (2),--
(i)
between the word "the" and the word "grant", appearing in
the first line, the words
"registration or" shall be inserted.
(ii)
in clause (a), for the words "the licensing fee", the words "the
registration or licensing fee" shall
be substituted;
(c)
for subsection (3) the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(3) The licensing authority
may, if it is a case of registration of a Gur Ghani/power crusher, other than a
commercial cane crusher, after making such inquiry as it may deem necessary,
register the said Gur Ghani/power crusher or, if it is a commercial cane
crusher, it may, if the applicant fulfils the conditions specified in Part B of
the Schedule and after making such inquiry as may be deemed appropriate, grant
him the licence in the form specified in Part C of the Schedule.";
(d)
in subsection (4), for the words "The licence", occurring in the
beginning, the words "The
registration made or the licence" shall be substituted; and
(e)
for subsection (5), the following shall be substituted, namely:
"(5) The procedure for the
renewal shall be the same as provided for original registration or grant of
licence."

An Ordinance

Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 29th January, 2002]
No. 1egis.1(12)80/588-93,
dated 29-1-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
6. Amendment of section 6 of
N.-W.F.P. Ord. XV of 1980.--In the said Ordinance, for section 6, the
following shall be substituted, namely:
"6. Fee.--(i)
There shall be charged a fee for the registration of a Gur Ghani/power crusher
or grant of a licence under this Ordinance at the following rates:
(i) registration fee for Gur
Ghani/power crusher, other than a commercial cane crusher;
Rs.500 per year
(ii) licence fee for commercial
cane crusher.
Rs.50,000 per year
(2) The fee prescribed under
subsection (1) may be revised by Government from time to time by a Notification
in the Official Gazette.
(3) The fee shall be deposited in
the State Bank of Pakistan or any Government Treasury under the head
"1300-Miscellaneous Receipts-1390 -Receipts from installation/renewal of
Power Crushers."
